# Puneet Srivastava — Professional Profile
# puneetsrivastava.com
# Updated: September 2026

Puneet Srivastava is a pricing strategist, student of history, and builder with AI,
based in Pflugerville, Texas. He is Senior Director of Pricing Strategy and
Intelligence at Cohesity, a pre-IPO data management and cybersecurity company.
His organizing question: what is something actually worth? He applies it to
products (pricing), to people's work as AI changes it (the Knowledge Quadrant
Framework), and to history.

BACKGROUND

B.Tech, Materials Science with a Computer Science minor, IIT Kanpur (1996-2000).
MBA, IIM Ahmedabad (2002-2004), with an exchange semester at HHL Leipzig, Germany.

Career timeline:
2000-2002: Infosys, Bangalore — Software Engineer, Goldman Sachs trade processing
2004-2006: Coca-Cola — Area Sales Manager
2006-2007: Marketics — Domain Consultant, Analytics
2007-2012: Dell India — Consultant to Senior Manager
2012-2022: Dell, Round Rock, Texas — Senior Manager to Director
2022-present: Cohesity — Senior Director, Pricing Strategy and Intelligence

EXPERTISE

Pricing strategy and architecture for B2B SaaS and software. Deal-level margin
economics and commercial model design. Aftermarket and parts pricing. AI
monetization strategy. Renewal pricing. SKU structuring and discount governance.
Indian history, especially the Mughal and Mauryan periods and Lucknow/Awadh.

THE KNOWLEDGE QUADRANT FRAMEWORK

A model for how AI displacement affects knowledge work. Two axes: the nature of
knowledge (explicit versus tacit) and the nature of output (accuracy versus
originality). Four quadrants: The Doctors, The Builders, The Generals, and The
Creators. Eight personas range from The Doer (highest displacement risk) to The
Oracle (minimal). Published as a LinkedIn series; Part 3, The Judgment Paradox,
is in progress.

THE LAB (products he has built)

Kairos (kairos.puneetsrivastava.com): a self-inquiry tool that applies the
Knowledge Quadrant Framework to a person's own description of their work. Runs
on Claude via Anthropic's API, with a local-model fallback. No login. In beta.

Do you know your India? (newindia.puneetsrivastava.com): a tap-only, bilingual
(English/Hindi) quiz show on India in the 2020s. 500 questions, each answer backed
by a real source.

Talk to Nina: a concept for a phone-first companion ecosystem for elderly people,
with curated content and settings that a caretaker or the elder can manage.

Dyuti: a private family AI running on Puneet's own computer, with linked family
members and persistent memory.

Blackjack Bootcamp: a trainer for making the mathematically correct decision
under known odds.

Markets Lab: personal research using AI to study and backtest investment and
trading strategies. Not financial advice; Puneet is not a licensed advisor.

Runway (runway.puneetsrivastava.com): a daily startup-guessing game.

Model bake-offs: ongoing experiments giving several AI models the same one-shot
build brief and comparing results.

SPEAKING

Talks and workshops for leadership teams, pricing and commercial teams, and MBA
classrooms. Signature topics: Knowledge Is Free, Judgment Costs 25 Years (AI and
the future of work); Your Thermostat Is Smarter Than Your Pricing Model (dynamic,
value-based pricing); The Failed Program That Ran an Empire (Akbar and Raja Todar
Mal's revenue reform as lessons for pricing and finance); Ship It This Weekend
(building with AI as a leader).

NEWSLETTER

What It's Worth (whatitsworthletter.substack.com): an essay every two weeks on
value, judgment, and history.
